name: aim2d
description: Aiming with a pointer: the point of the world under the mouse or the finger, seen through the camera, kept within reach of whoever aims. A spell cast where one clicks, a gun that turns towards the cursor, a grappling hook, a cursor that shows where a jump would land.

components.name: Aim
components.description: Puts the entity's Position on the point of the world under the pointer, whose place on the screen (in pixels of the game's window) the actions pointer_x and pointer_y give (none: the actions named pointer_x and pointer_y), seen through the oldest camera2d.Camera. With from, the entity that answers to that tag (a tag.Tag) is the one who aims: the point is kept within range units of it (0: no limit). With lock, the Position follows the pointer only while the entity is transform2d.Disabled: it is placed where it is when it starts working, and stays there (a wall raised where one clicked). The module keeps x and y, the point under the pointer itself; distance, how far it is from the one who aims; and dir_x and dir_y, the direction from the one who aims to it (a length of 1; 1, 0 when they are at the same place).

systems.name: aim
systems.description: Places every Aim entity under the pointer, within its range, after the camera has moved.
